attacks.name: UV Strike
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains |!power| equal to the |!damage| dealt.
|!wild| |!hit| |*Heating Up|: After this attack is resolved, this character gains 1 |<flare_sunspot>Flare| token.

attacks.name: Dark Solar Blast
steps: |!wild| |!hit| |*Thermokinetic Concussion|: After this attack is resolved, other characters within |!range| 2 of the defender suffer 1 |!damage|. Characters dealt |!damage| by this special rule do not gain |!power| for this |!damage|. This character cannot damage itself with this special rule.

superPowers.name: High Energy Conversion
superPowers.body: Choose an interactive terrain feature or enemy character, both within |!range| 2 and of |!size| equal to or less than the number of |<flare_sunspot>Flare| tokens this character has, and Throw it |!range_small|. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Sunburn
superPowers.body: |*Action|: This character Advances its Speed. If it has 3 |<flare_sunspot>Flare| tokens, it instead Advances |!range_large| and gains the |*Flight| |!innate| superpower during this Advance. After Advancing, it makes an attack action. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Thermokinesis
superPowers.body: Before rolling attack dice, this character may use this superpower. Spend 1 or more |<flare_sunspot>Flare| tokens. Add 1 die to the attack roll for each Flare token spent. If at least 1 Flare token was spent, after the attack is resolved, the defender gains the |§incinerate§Incinerate| special condition.

superPowers.name: Flare State
superPowers.body: After this character ends a movement, it gains 1 |<flare_sunspot>Flare| token. This character can have a maximum of 3 Flare tokens at any time.|\|Additionally, when this character would become Dazed or KO'd, this character may choose to spend all its Flare tokens. If it does, this character deals 1 |!damage| to all enemy characters within |!range| X of it, where X is the number of Flare tokens spent. Then this character is Dazed or KO'd.
